SegmentedControl.use: pick exactly one option from a small fixed set, all visible at once

rules.options: Array of {value, label, disabled?}; renders one radio button per option with a sliding indicator behind the selected one.
rules.value: Controlled: pass value + onValueChange. Omitting value makes it uncontrolled from defaultValue (or the first enabled option).
rules.vs.Tabs: Segmented picks a VALUE (a filter, a view mode); Tabs picks a PANEL of content to show. Use Tabs when each option has its own content region, Segmented when the options are just states of the same view.
rules.vs.RadioGroup: Segmented is for 2-5 short, mutually-exclusive options meant to be scanned as one control (role="radiogroup" under the hood); prefer RadioGroup for a longer or vertically-stacked list.

SegmentedControl.basic: <SegmentedControl options={[{ value: "day", label: "Day" }, { value: "week", label: "Week" }, { value: "month", label: "Month" }]} value={range} onValueChange={setRange} />
